scenario.opening_question: What balance of hands-on practice versus expert lectures do we want for our workshop experience?

options.name: Advanced Deep Learning Hands-On Workshop
options.upside: Intensive practical coding sessions with real datasets
options.tradeoff: Less time for networking and theory lectures
options.concern: May be too specialized for some lab members’ interests

options.name: Data Ethics and Governance Seminar Series
options.upside: Strong focus on emerging ethical frameworks and policy discussions
options.tradeoff: Limited practical exercises and coding practice
options.concern: May feel too theoretical and less technical for some attendees

options.name: Applied Machine Learning with Cloud Tools Workshop
options.upside: Hands-on use of popular cloud ML platforms with guided projects
options.tradeoff: Higher cost uses entire budget leaving no room for extras
options.concern: Requires some prior cloud experience to keep up

options.name: Data Visualization and Storytelling Workshop
options.upside: Focus on communicating data insights effectively to diverse audiences
options.tradeoff: Less emphasis on advanced modeling or coding techniques
options.concern: May not satisfy those wanting deeper algorithmic content
